summary: The fits returned a minimum without a verdict: nonconvergence, an indefinite Hessian, the mu = 0 boundary and a conditional NLL below the global one went unreported.

database_specific.introduced_basis: the defective lines are in the repository's first commit, the 0.3.0 import; earlier releases are not in this repository

observables: fit status of shape-limit, shape-gof and contour (likelihood_limits.py)
impact.bias: a fit that had not converged (EDM above 1e-5, non-finite NLL, Hessian not positive definite) was reported as a result, and q was clipped when the conditional NLL fell below the global one; the Newton steps themselves are unchanged
impact.trigger: poorly constrained or boundary fits: few events, strong nuisance correlations, mu near 0

remedy: rerun the fit with a release that has the fix (0.6.11 or later) and read its fit_diagnostics; a failed or incomplete status means the result does not stand
